import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv', columns=['amount', 'is_fraud', 'transaction_type', 'hour_of_day'])

# Convert is_fraud column to categorical for plotting
df['is_fraud'] = df['is_fraud'].astype('category')

# Create a bar chart to compare transaction types
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.countplot(x='transaction_type', hue='is_fraud', data=df)
plt.title('Transaction Type vs. Fraud Status')
plt.xlabel('Transaction Type')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.legend(title='Fraud Status')
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a histogram to compare hour of day
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.histplot(x='hour_of_day', hue='is_fraud', data=df, bins=24, kde=True)
plt.title('Hour of Day vs. Fraud Status')
plt.xlabel('Hour of Day')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.legend(title='Fraud Status')
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure

plt.title('Amount vs. Fraud Status')
plt.xlabel('Fraud Status')
plt.ylabel('Amount')
plt.legend(title='Fraud Status')
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
